extracted.intended_audience: practitioners seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; patent attorneys and counsel involved in USPTO enrollment/discipline matters
extracted.subtask_description: An official decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58; describes the filing, supporting affidavit, the materials reviewed, and the Director's grant of reinstatement. Geared toward practitioners and counsel involved in enrollment and discipline proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Daniel M. Maffeo (Registration Number 61,706) received on January 31, 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document indicates a petition must be filed and received (with identifying registration number and date). The page does not list additional procedural filing requirements or forms, only that the petition was received and considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Maffeo has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A supporting affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is presented as part of a reinstatement petition. The decision references the rule but does not reproduce § 11.58 or specify the affidavit's required contents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of petition, affidavit, and all record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision indicates that the Director evaluates the petition holistically — considering the petition, supporting affidavit, and any record material relevant to eligibility. No explicit factor list or scoring rubric is provided on the page; the phrase 'all information in the record material to his eligibility' implies consideration of any relevant documentary or factual record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's determination of appropriateness and authority to grant reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Maffeo to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ultimate decision to grant reinstatement rests with the Director (here signed by the Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director). The page records the Director's discretion to determine whether reinstatement is 'appropriate' but does not enumerate the standards used to reach that determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification/Service to Counsel
rubrics_metrics.description: Copy to: Emil Ali, counsel for Mr. Daniel M. Maffeo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision includes notation of service/copy to counsel; procedural practice includes providing copies of the decision to the petitioner's counsel. The page does not specify additional service requirements or timing.
